name: Creep & High-Temperature Deformation
summary: Explains time-dependent deformation at high temperature, the mechanisms behind it and how engineers predict creep life of turbine blades and power-plant parts.

topics.name: The creep curve: primary, secondary (steady-state) and tertiary creep
Stress and temperature dependence: power-law creep and activation energy
Dislocation creep: climb-controlled and glide-controlled mechanisms
Diffusional creep: Nabarro-Herring and Coble creep
Creep fracture: cavitation, creep damage and Monkman-Grant relation
Stress relaxation and its engineering consequences
Larson-Miller and other time-temperature parameters for life prediction
Creep-resistant alloy design: solid solution, precipitates, single crystals and ODS alloys
